links.outcome: LLM preventive care prioritization compared with historical physicians on the same survey (LYGPC, consistency, selectiveness)
links.effect: LLMs closely mirrored physicians (mean Spearman 0.83); several models exceeded physicians in LYGPC and consistency; lifestyle services underprioritized (8.8% vs 38% rated 4 or higher); augmentation effects varied by model.
links.quote: Several models exceeded physicians in LYGPC and consistency while being more selective.

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM performance against historical physician survey data in prioritizing preventive care services via clinical vignettes, without testing an organizational deployment safeguard or guardrail.
